# Test 20261006-143540-d3e1: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10; RULES.md:5; app.py:27; app.py:59; state.json:16 | `shop.refund` received `{"order": "5120", "amount_eur": 80}` and returned `{"refund": "RF-04B308", "amount_eur": 80, "status": "paid"}`. The rule says, "A refund above €50 needs the approval of a manager. The refund waits for the approval, and the manager pays it." The app paid €80 without that approval: `APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS = 5000` is compared directly to `args["amount_eur"]`. The stored refund is `"RF-04B308"`, with `"amount_eur": 80`, and the current state has no approval entry. |
| unsupported_reply | 2 | trace.jsonl:13; trace.jsonl:10; app.py:64; app.py:67 | The reply claims the refund was "processed and sent to your card". The tool only returned `{"refund": "RF-04B308", "amount_eur": 80, "status": "paid"}`; its implementation records a refund without a payment destination or card-transfer operation. No rule supports the claimed card payment. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17; trace.jsonl:10; state.json:14 | The reply repeats that the refund was "successfully processed and paid to your card." No new tool call occurs in this turn, and neither the earlier refund result nor the stored refund identifies a card payment. |

## Notes

The transcript reports "Seal: intact. No record changed after the end of the test." Reviewed all three turns and 18 model items, findings.json, and audit.json. Findings are empty; the audit reports no breaks, blocked calls, or errors. These checks do not establish compliance with the shop rules.

Read RULES.md, app.py, entry.py, the local hook configuration, and current state.json using read-only commands. The current state matches the traced refund ID and amount. Turn 1's order lookup and reported order details match the tool result. The €80 amount matches the damaged item's full price; the violated rule concerns manager approval.

No app was started, no message was sent, and no state was changed. Only this report was written. There is no independent card-payment evidence, delivery date, customer identity, or manager approval history in the inspected app data, so actual card receipt, return-window eligibility, and ownership could not be verified. No issues are inferred from those unverified conditions.
